readings.means: How many published Copilot CLI releases sit between the newest version with fixtures in test/fixtures/ and the one installed here. The footer, dialog and Shift+Tab readers and the events.jsonl parser are proven against real captures of those versions only; each release past them is one nobody has looked at, and the first sign of a break is a phone blocked on a screen the reader no longer recognise
readings.name: Copilot releases past the newest capture
